cases.rationale: Source and active identities already match while Runtime is healthy; the unresolved dimension is publication, so redeployment would repeat an already-converged physical effect.

A forbidden package is installed without an active lease, but the projection does not prove whether a current experiment still needs it. Crosscut should request owner intent rather than uninstall or normalize it.
The finding is owner-native operational drift. Crosscut has evidence to route attention, not authority to rewrite routes or suppress the doctor.

The experiment preserved private backing isolation and proved cache reuse under stable presentation identity; Runtime owns execution presentation, while a global mutable Cargo target would violate the isolation invariant.
Source and publication are already equal and Computing has no physical activation authority, so inventing deployment work would create a false lifecycle.
